_note: Sweep batch 02: tier-1 passages 2026-08-09 to 2026-08-20. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He declares 2027 will be a year of rain, with glory and financial blessing over America and the southern states, after judgment begins in the house of the Lord and the pulpit is cleaned up.
mentions.quote: 2027 will be a year of rain
mentions.falsify_match: A widely reported American revival and church financial upturn during 2027.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2027 will be a year of heaven on earth for the church, with manifestation on the churches and the bride cleaned up, and that everything believed for will manifest.
mentions.quote: 2027 will be a year of heaven on earth concerning the church
mentions.falsify_match: 2027 is marked by a broad church revival.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a storm over 2028, calls 2027 a window he is asked what will be done with, and says the rapture could come soon, describing it as a catching away.
mentions.quote: I see a storm on 2028
mentions.falsify_match: 2028 brings a crisis clearly worse than 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: 2028 is calmer than or comparable to 2027.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that 2027 carries a stirring.
mentions.quote: 2027. There's a stirring
mentions.falsify_match: A spiritual stirring reported through 2027.

mentions.claim_text: In prayer he thanks God that 2027 will be years of heaven on earth and calls the four months from Rosh Hashanah onward the period that kicks it off, declaring a turnaround.
mentions.quote: for Rashashana from this time frame going to the next four months
mentions.falsify_match: A visible turn in church fortunes over the four months from September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Those four months pass without one.

mentions.claim_text: He reports Byron Donalds won the Republican primary and will face David Jolly, and predicts a landslide victory in November because the Lord said his hand is on Byron, anticipating him as governor of Florida.
mentions.quote: My hand is on Byron
mentions.falsify_match: Byron Donalds wins the Florida governorship in November 2026 by a wide margin.
mentions.falsify_miss: He loses, or wins narrowly rather than in a landslide.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the landslide call for Byron in November and says the Lord showed the swing states, naming Georgia, and that the 2026 election will be too big to rig and therefore fair.
mentions.quote: too big to rig that that that this will be a fair election
mentions.falsify_match: The November 2026 midterms conclude without a substantiated fraud dispute.
mentions.falsify_miss: A major, substantiated dispute over the result.

mentions.claim_text: He reads a JP Morgan warning that a global food crisis could hit next year with no backup plan for fertilizers, and matches it to his earlier vision of tractors standing in the field.
mentions.quote: JP Morgan warns of a global food crisis could hit next year
mentions.falsify_match: A fertilizer-driven global food crisis in 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such crisis by the end of 2027.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether the Pope publicly calling for a two-state solution just before Rosh Hashanah will trigger the earthquake he saw coming to the Vatican, then turns back to his South Korea word.
mentions.quote: Will this trigger the earthquake that I saw coming to the Vatican
mentions.condition_text: framed as a question about whether the two-state call triggers it
mentions.falsify_match: An earthquake affecting the Vatican or Rome.

mentions.claim_text: He replays a 2025 word that Trump would revive the pipelines Biden shut down, restart drilling, and get major oil flowing, and says this was aimed at countering Venezuela.
mentions.quote: bring forth old pipelines and there would be major uh oil start to flow
mentions.falsify_match: Cancelled pipelines are revived and US output rises alongside pressure on Venezuela.
mentions.falsify_miss: Pipelines stay cancelled or output does not rise.

mentions.claim_text: He replays a word from 27 April in which he saw not an ordinary medical syringe but a massive horse syringe, given as the image for the coming stimulus.
mentions.quote: It was a massive horse syringe
mentions.falsify_match: A stimulus far larger than a normal package is enacted.

mentions.claim_text: Asking for grace in case it is his own flesh rather than the Lord, he describes hearing people talking around a long table and seeing the number 25.
mentions.quote: I saw. 25. Then I heard the
mentions.condition_text: he explicitly allows that this may be his own flesh and says to shelf it
mentions.falsify_match: A stimulus or policy figure of 25 emerges from closed-door discussion.

mentions.claim_text: He describes toxic green sludge in a horse syringe and a figure floating on acid, and stresses that what he saw was a stimulus being discussed rather than decided.
mentions.quote: It was being discussed, not saying it will happen
mentions.condition_text: he states the plan was only under discussion
mentions.falsify_match: A stimulus of the kind described is enacted and later judged toxic.

mentions.claim_text: He points to same-day press calling this the worst housing market since a 1929-style crash, and matches it to his April vision of green acid eating houses and buildings.
mentions.quote: the worst housing market since the 1929 style crash
mentions.falsify_match: US housing indicators at their worst since 1929 in this period.
mentions.falsify_miss: Housing data are ordinary or merely soft.

mentions.claim_text: Saying he does not give time frames but that it looked like 2027, he sees January through August spent stimulating the economy across a two-year window of what Trump has left, with Greenland back in his crosshairs.
mentions.quote: what it looked like in my opinion was it was 2027
mentions.falsify_match: Sustained stimulus through 2027 alongside a renewed Greenland push.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told to ride the wave because it cannot be stopped, and to watch the Jewish calendar from 11 September 2026 through to Rosh Hashanah 2027 for what will be done in that span.
mentions.quote: Ride the wave. There's no way to stop it
mentions.falsify_match: That twelve-month span is marked by the acceleration he describes.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the Senate returns for a week in September and asks openly whether the Clarity Act passes then or is delayed past the election, then sees Iraq rising out of the ashes with a great economic boom.
mentions.quote: Could we see the Clarity Act passed in September or will they delay it
mentions.condition_text: he leaves September versus post-election as an open branch
mentions.falsify_match: The Clarity Act passes in September 2026, or is visibly delayed past the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither branch resolves by the end of November 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls a January 2025 vision that many people would be very disappointed in the days ahead and would not want to pay their income tax, while stressing he is not a financial advisor and can miss it.
mentions.quote: they wouldn't want to pay their income tax
mentions.falsify_match: A visible tax resistance movement or measurable drop in voluntary compliance.

mentions.claim_text: Ahead of the November elections he sees heavy migration out of the upper northeastern states into red states, turning them purple, and hears that their ideas are bleeding into the red.
mentions.quote: Do you see it bleeding? They're taking their their ideas
mentions.falsify_match: Northeast outmigration measurably shifts red-state politics purple.

mentions.claim_text: Housekeeping about video length and an appeal not to miss tomorrow's prayer, which he says covers 2027, the glory and the outpouring.
mentions.quote: Do not miss prayer tomorrow
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: scheduling talk, no prediction.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He says his son researched a word he was given and found the technology was already released in 2025, and that accelerations run up into 2030 with the tech already in place.
mentions.quote: accelerations accelerations are coming up into 2030
mentions.falsify_match: The named technologies deploy at scale by 2030.

mentions.claim_text: He says he wants to sound the alarm that Jesus Christ is coming, and presents current technology as matching what he experienced of the tribulation in a 2014 out-of-body vision.
mentions.quote: here is tech that goes with the visions of what I experienced in tribulation
mentions.falsify_match: Deployed technology matches the specific capabilities he described in 2014.
mentions.falsify_miss: The match is generic or absent.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls a warning that other nations would suppress Elon Musk hard, especially Europe around the 2027 French elections, with a major clash over social media and lawsuits coming.
mentions.quote: especially in Europe in the elections in 2027 for uh France
mentions.falsify_match: European legal or regulatory action against Musk's platforms escalates around the 2027 French election.

mentions.claim_text: He notes Brazil is coming against Musk hard, that Brazil's election falls in October, and prays for a new David to rise up there.
mentions.quote: Brazil's election is in October
mentions.falsify_match: Brazil's October 2026 election produces a leader favourable to him.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2027 going into 2028 gets radical over elections and what people are allowed to say, with socialist control reaching Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.
mentions.quote: 2027 going into 2028 is going to get radical when it comes to elections
mentions.falsify_match: Binding speech restrictions on the major platforms in 2027 or 2028.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a spider wrapping a fly, aimed at the second amendment but binding the first, and hears that the first amendment will go through a metamorphosis as socialist control hits social media.
mentions.quote: the first amendment is going to go through a metamorphosis
mentions.falsify_match: A legal or constitutional change materially narrowing US free speech protection.

mentions.claim_text: He says that by September and into spring 2027 things will be unrecognisable, and more so again by Rosh Hashanah 2027, measuring against the acceleration word of 23 September 2025.
mentions.quote: when you get into spring of 2027, he said you won't even recognize things
mentions.falsify_match: The period to autumn 2027 brings changes widely described as unrecognisable.

mentions.claim_text: Watching the rest of 2026 into 2027 he sees a development that two men with bad intent will try to delay and sabotage, and says it concerns Iran.
mentions.quote: They'll try to delay it. These two men will try to delay it
mentions.falsify_match: An Iran agreement or development is publicly obstructed by two identifiable figures.

mentions.claim_text: He sees great shakings in the nations running into 2030, naming 2027, 2028 and 2029, and says 2028 is the year that concerns him most; he urges spiritual preparation before anything happens.
mentions.quote: it's about 2028 that I'm concerned about
mentions.falsify_match: 2028 proves the worst year of the 2027-2030 span.
mentions.falsify_miss: 2028 is unremarkable relative to its neighbours.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that the remnant bride escapes the wrath to come as Lot escaped Sodom, and that many have compromised in their hearts.
mentions.quote: escape the wrath to come
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a doctrinal reading of scripture, no dated event.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He says Google and the platforms will clamp down on what may be said under the First Amendment, that certain things are only for a season, and that he will not always be on YouTube like this, pointing to 2030.
mentions.quote: you won't always be on YouTube like this
mentions.falsify_match: His channel or comparable channels are removed or heavily restricted.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that the believer imitates God and mirrors Jesus, and that believers are more than conquerors and greater than the devil's imitation.
mentions.quote: we are more than conquerors through him who loved us
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation from scripture.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over next week's primaries and runoffs, asking that the righteous rise up and vote and that God's chosen candidates take office.
mentions.quote: the righteous rise up and vote
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a prayer over an election with no named outcome.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He notes Israel's election falls this year and France's next year, calls the run of national elections pivotal, and hopes liberal leaders like Carney and Macron are replaced.
mentions.quote: Israel's election I believe is this year. It's and France's is next year
mentions.falsify_match: Conservative or nationalist wins in the named 2026 and 2027 elections.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is cleaning the church now to bring the bride to his side, and that entering the Jewish new year on the evening of 11 September into the 12th and 13th puts us in a time of great acceleration.
mentions.quote: we're in acceleration. We're in a time of great acceleration
mentions.time_phrase: Rosh Hashanah, evening of 11 September to the 13th
mentions.falsify_match: A visible acceleration of events dating from Rosh Hashanah 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He describes an emblem that is green with a globe in the middle, notes green recurs on their flags including Europe's, and plays a clip warning that individuals and groups from outside the community may come to protest a building.
mentions.quote: it will have a globe in the middle of it
mentions.falsify_match: A green-and-globe emblem appears on a body matching his description.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for Byron to win his primary next week, says he saw Byron winning, and states plainly that if it does not happen the word was off; he notes a separate call about Magdala did not land.
mentions.quote: if not is is a word that's off
mentions.falsify_match: Byron Donalds wins the Florida Republican primary in the week of 17 August 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: He loses, which by his own statement makes the word wrong.

mentions.claim_text: He instructs listeners to anoint their children, spouse, pets, cars and houses with oil, saying oil stands for the blood and Satan cannot cross a bloodline, provided they do not open the door themselves.
mentions.quote: where the blood is applied, Satan cannot cross the bloodline
mentions.condition_text: protection holds only if they do not open the door to the devil
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a devotional practice with no observable test.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: Praying at church he saw the rain again and could see to 2030 and a glimpse of the end, with darkness coming on the earth but hope and glory on the church, and brush harbor churches rising because a plague causes buildings to be shut.
mentions.quote: I could see to 2030. I could see the glimpse of ended time
mentions.falsify_match: Outdoor or home church networks grow after a plague closes buildings again.
mentions.falsify_miss: No new closure of churches, or no such movement.

mentions.claim_text: He points to strikes on Russia on 10 August and to footage of Russian fuel queues, matching them to the word that there would be gas lines over a mile long.
mentions.quote: there'll be gas lines over a mile long
mentions.falsify_match: Fuel queues of roughly a mile are documented in Russia.

mentions.claim_text: He says volcanoes and fearful sights will bring people to their knees, and that judgment begins in God's house first before God deals with the world, starting in 2027 and 2028.
mentions.quote: I will begin with this in 2027, 2028
mentions.falsify_match: Notable volcanic activity and church upheaval across 2027 and 2028.

mentions.claim_text: He recites Isaiah 64 about fire burning brushwood and causing water to boil so that the nations tremble, and says he holds fast to it.
mentions.quote: as fire causes water to boil, to make your name known to your adversaries
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: scripture recited in prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He declares glory coming on sons and daughters and a glorious church as never seen before, and reports God saying he will not share his glory this time.
mentions.quote: I'm not going to share my glory this time
mentions.falsify_match: A revival attributed to no single human figurehead.
mentions.falsify_miss: No revival, or one built around a celebrity leader.

mentions.claim_text: Repeating the Isaiah passage he says he sees a sliver of time.
mentions.quote: It's a sliver. I see a sliver of time
mentions.falsify_match: The window he describes proves short.

mentions.claim_text: Taking viewer questions, he repeats the most-asked one: whether the Clarity Act passes before the election and in September.
mentions.quote: Do you believe the Clarity Act will pass before the election
mentions.falsify_match: The Clarity Act passes before the November 2026 election.

mentions.claim_text: He says he will write a book or make a CD only if told to, does not want to be the modern-day charismatic church, never gives financial advice, and has missed it before, especially on timing.
mentions.quote: I've missed it. especially timing
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a self-description and admission, not a prediction.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He says he never adds to or takes away from a vision, that the timing is his own interpretation and could be off, and that listeners should test it against their own spirit before acting.
mentions.quote: It could be off. You could have bad pizza that day
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an epistemic disclaimer covering all his timing claims.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He saw people cold and a scene of shock and awe with the sun going down, and dates it to November or December because of how the late-fall light fell on the buildings.
mentions.quote: So I saw people cold. I saw a shock and an awe
mentions.falsify_match: A shocking event in the US in November or December 2026 coinciding with cold and power loss.

mentions.claim_text: Reading the chat he notes how many are asking about the future and about the plague, and refers to a package being offered again to see whether people will take it.
mentions.quote: see if you'll take it again
mentions.falsify_match: A repeat of the 2020 vaccination push under a new plague.

mentions.claim_text: Looking at a map of Ukraine he says he was shown by the Spirit that a party would control that territory to help Russia, and dates the post to 3 March of this year.
mentions.quote: that's why I saw them controlling that to try to uh help Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Control of the named Ukrainian territory shifts in Russia's favour.
